## Play: Data Sense

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Data Sense (10 to 15 min)" icon="false"}
How good is your eye for data? In **Guess r** you estimate the [correlation coefficient]{.term} from a [scatter plot]{.term} and learn its traps. In **Find the Outlier** you tap the points a rule would flag as an [outlier]{.term}, then see how much they move the mean and r. Use it to practice looking at data before you summarize it.

{{< game data-sense title="Data Sense" height="860" >}}
:::
